Erika Gardiner is a highly skilled tattoo artist specializing in geometric and traditional styles. Her impeccable attention to cleanliness is evident in every aspect of her work, ensuring a safe and sterile environment for all her clients at Black Diamond Tattoo. Erika's professionalism is consistently praised, making her one of the most sought-after artists for anyone seeking intricate and precise tattoo designs.
